name: United States, 1949
description: January 1949. Truman has just won re-election. The North Atlantic Treaty is three months from signing, the Soviet bomb is months away, and China is falling to the Communists.

opening.headline: Truman's Second Term
paragraphs: On 20 January Harry Truman takes the oath for a term almost nobody expected him to win. The war has been over for less than four years, and the peace has already split in two.

Berlin has been under Soviet blockade since June, fed and heated from the air. In China, Communist armies are closing on the Yangtze. In Washington, diplomats are drafting a treaty that would bind the United States to the defence of Western Europe in peacetime, something it has not done since 1800.
America holds the only atomic bomb, around half of the world's manufacturing and most of its monetary gold. How long that lead lasts is now in your hands.

quote.text: The peoples of the earth face the future with grave uncertainty, composed almost equally of great hopes and great fears.
quote.source: Harry S. Truman, inaugural address, 20 January 1949
